roadmap_steps: Year 1: Strengthen Python + DSA fundamentals, finish 2-3 guided ML courses
Year 2: Build 3-4 practice ML projects (prediction models, simple CV/NLP), contribute to GitHub
Year 3: Land an early internship as ML/Data intern, keep building project portfolio
Year 4: Capstone ML project, apply for AI/ML Engineer entry roles
paths.rationale: Directly matches the stated AI/ML Engineer goal and learn-by-building preference, while using existing Python/SQL/Git basics as a starting point.
